intro: There's a skinny dog at the entrance. It's watching me.
It isn't barking. That worries me more.

text: I yelled and it ran. I'm through.
It bit my arm. I got it off me.
I went around the side. It didn't even move.
It saw me. I had to go back and come in from behind. Lost time.
I tossed it half a cracker. It followed me a while, then stayed behind.
success.memory: the skinny dog that followed me for a while

text: It wanted nothing to do with it. Growled at the cracker and at me.

intro: A tall shelf, full at the top. Everything down low is already picked clean.

text: Made it up. There are cans.
It came down with me on it.
Knocked a couple of things down with a broom handle.
Nothing that works. Leaving it.

intro: I hear something in the basement.
Could be water. Could be someone.

text: It was water dripping on a metal sheet. And there are boxes down here.
success.memory: the dark basement where nobody was waiting after all

text: It wasn't water. Something jumped me in the dark.
Threw a stone. Nothing moved. Just water.
Threw a stone and something moved down there. I'm leaving.
Leaving. It's not worth it.
Ran out and caught myself on a door.

intro: The fuel pump's cover has been pried open. There might be something left inside.

text: Got a couple of parts that work.
Everything jammed. Cut myself on the metal.
There were batteries on the counter. Still good, I think.
The shop's empty. Not even batteries.

intro: There's an overturned car in the middle of the street.
I can see a backpack inside.

text: Dragged myself in and got the backpack. There's stuff in it.
The car shifted when I got in. Pinned my leg.
Popped it with the crowbar. Scrap, but it's useful.
Made a lot of noise and it didn't open.
Moving on. I don't like that backpack sitting there alone.
Moving on. But I keep thinking about that backpack.

intro: There's a radio on in a window. It's playing static.
Someone left it on. Or turned it on recently.

text: Unplugged it and I'm bringing it. It has batteries inside.
success.memory: the radio playing static in a window

text: It fell and broke when I grabbed it. Got the batteries out anyway.
There are numbers in the static. Someone is counting.
success.memory: the numbers hidden in the static

text: Just static. It gave me chills.

intro: There's a metal shutter halfway down. It's dark on the other side.

text: Crawled under. There's a first-aid box on the wall.
The shutter slammed down. Caught my back.
Made a terrible noise but it went up. Not much inside.
It won't budge. Hurt my shoulder.

intro: There's someone else here. They saw me.
They've got a pipe in their hand. Not moving.

text: I talked calmly. They said they were heading south. We left each other alone.
success.memory: the stranger with the pipe heading south

text: They didn't want to talk. Threw the pipe at me and ran.
Got behind some furniture until they left.
They found me. We stared at each other a long time. Then they left.
They ran off and left their bag.
Hit me with the pipe. Took everything I had.

intro: To keep going I have to cross the roof. The metal sheets are loose.

text: Made it across. There's an untouched storeroom on the other side.
success.memory: the loose roof of the school

text: A sheet gave way. I fell into the classroom below.
Found a service ladder. Took longer, but I made it.
There's no other way. Turning back.

intro: A pack. Six, seven dogs. They haven't seen me yet.

text: Climbed a dumpster. Waited for them to leave.
They got a bite in before I made it up.
They didn't even smell me. I'm through.
success.memory: the pack that let me pass

text: They smelled me. I ran until I couldn't.
I yelled, banged a sheet of metal. They scattered.
There were too many.

intro: Armed people ahead. Three, at least.
They're searching the same place I am.

text: I offered information to get past. They took it.
success.memory: the looters who let me pass because I talked

text: They wanted nothing to do with me. Took what I was carrying.
They left. I'm keeping what they dropped.
They saw me. I had to run.

options.label: Rob them while they aren't looking

text: Took a whole backpack.
One of them turned around. Fired.

intro: It smells of gas. Strong.
What I'm looking for is on the other side.

options.label: Cover your face and run through

text: Made it. My throat's burning, but I made it.
I got dizzy. Fell. Woke up outside, don't know how.

options.label: Find the valve and shut it

text: Shut the valve. The air's clearing slowly.
The valve's stuck. Better get out.
There's a window on the far side. Went in that way.
No other way in. Lost time.

intro: A freight car with a padlock.
Something is rolling around inside.

text: It's open. Toolboxes.
Broke my crowbar. And the noise drew something in.
Dropped through the hatch. There's a bit of everything.
Slipped off the roof.
Leaving it. Whatever's rolling can keep rolling.
Leaving it. But now I'll always wonder.

intro: A whole archive. Folders, index cards, maps.
Some say "Silence" on the cover.

text: Reports from before. One folder says "Project Echo". I'm keeping the important parts in my head.
success.memory: the folders that said Silence on the cover

text: I don't understand any of it. Acronyms, numbers.

options.label: Take all the paper you can

text: Loaded a box. Heavy, but good for starting fires if nothing else.
The box split on the stairs.

intro: There's a wounded man against a wall.
He's asking for water.

text: I bandaged his leg. He told me where he'd stashed supplies.
success.memory: the wounded man I helped

text: I did what I could. It wasn't enough.
He had medicine. I'm taking it.
He wasn't that hurt. Stuck something in my arm.
Moving on. Not looking back.
Moving on. I can hear him calling after me for a long time.

intro: The basement is flooded waist-deep.
Something that looks like a box is floating down there.

text: Cold as hell, but I got it. Tools.
Slipped on the stairs. Swallowed water.

options.label: Rig a hook and fish it out

text: Pulled it over with a wire. Dry inside.
It sank deeper. Gone.

intro: There are bare wires on the floor. I can hear a hum.
There's still power somewhere.

text: Found the breaker box and flipped it. Taking the fuses.
Got a jolt. My hand's numb.
Stepping over, slow and easy.
Bad step. Sparks. Jumped just in time.

options.label: Find where the power comes from

text: A battery bank in the machine room. Still holding some charge.
Couldn't find it. And the hum is getting to me.

intro: A huge wasp nest over the door I need.
The buzzing never stops.

options.label: Smoke them out and go through

text: Stunned them with wet rags and fire. I'm through.
They got angry. Stung my face.
Through the bathroom window. Slower, but in one piece.
There's no other way. Turning back.

intro: A reinforced door. Silence on the other side.
It has a combination lock.

text: Seven, three, one, nine. It opened. I don't know why I tried those numbers.
success.memory: the door that opened with the Voice's numbers

text: Nothing. I gave up.
Knocked the pins out one by one. A storeroom inside.
Broke a fingernail and nothing else.

intro: There's a map of the neighborhood on the wall with red marks.
Someone wrote notes by hand.

text: Copied all of it. Some streets are crossed out: places to avoid, I think.
success.memory: the map with red crosses

text: Can't read the handwriting. Taking what I can.

options.label: Tear it down and bring it

text: Bringing it rolled up.
It crumbled in my hands.

intro: A shot. Hit the wall, close.
Someone's shooting from a rooftop.

options.label: Take cover and wait for night

text: Waited hours. They left. Moving on.
My legs shook the whole time.
Made it. Breathing.
It grazed my leg.

options.label: Shout that you're not here to steal

text: They stopped shooting. Waved me on.
success.memory: the shooter who let me pass

text: They didn't care. Fired again.

intro: Part of the ceiling came down. I'm on the wrong side.

text: Opened a gap. There was something useful underneath.
Everything shifted again. Hit my shoulder.
Crawled through the duct. I'm out.
Got stuck for a long time. A very long time.

intro: Rats. Hundreds. Pouring out of the sewers.

text: They scattered. The storeroom is clear.
Nearly set the whole place on fire.
They went right past me. Didn't even look.
One bit my ankle.

intro: A walk-in freezer. The door is jammed from the inside.

text: There are cans inside that survived everything.
Hurt my back pushing.
Jammed from the inside. Better not to know.
Not opening it. But I heard something knock.

intro: There's a wire at ankle height.
Someone set a trap.

text: Disarmed it. The mechanism is good for parts.
It sprang. Cut my leg.
Avoided it. Whoever set it can't be far.
There was a second one. I stepped on it.

intro: A dust storm blew up. I can't see two meters ahead.

text: Got inside a bus. It passed in two hours.
Found nothing. Covered up with my jacket.
Came out right on target. No idea how.
success.memory: the storm I crossed blind

text: Got lost. Took twice as long to find the road.

intro: The airport runway is wide open.
I have to cross it. Nowhere to hide.

text: Made it. Nobody fired.
Something chased me all the way to the hangar.
At night, slowly. Made it.
The night has its own things. Got there shaking.

intro: A cargo plane split in half.
The hold is intact.

text: Crates of spare parts. This is worth gold.
The fuselage gave way. I was trapped for a while.
The plane's radio still has good parts.
Nothing useful. And a smell I won't describe.

intro: The dam's floodgates are groaning.
The water is pushing from the other side.

text: Wedged it with a bar. Took what I could from the control room.
It broke loose. The water dragged me a few meters.
Went up the service stairs. You can see everything from up here.
The stairs are rotten. Got down however I could.

intro: The turbine hall. One is still turning, slowly.

text: Coils, bearings, copper. All of it useful.
It caught my sleeve. Yanked myself free.
Stopped it. Now I can take my time.
I can't make sense of the controls. Better not touch anything.

intro: The antenna tower is forty meters tall.
There's a box at the top that wasn't there before.

text: Climbed. Terrible wind. Brought the box down.
success.memory: the forty-meter tower

text: A rung came loose.

options.label: Look at it from below with whatever you have

text: From down here you can tell: it's a relay. Someone maintains it.
Can't make anything out.

intro: A camp. Fresh campfires.
There are people, and they don't look friendly.

text: We traded news. They gave me food.
success.memory: the camp that gave me food

text: They took everything and ran me off.
They have radios. They're listening to the same thing we are.
A dog smelled me. I ran.
Took batteries and medicine.
They caught me.

intro: Found a device in the antenna room.
It's not from before the Silence. Someone installed it after.
It repeats the numbers. Seven, three, one, nine.

text: There's a plate: ECHO-7. It relays something coming from farther away.
success.memory: the device that repeated the numbers

text: I can't figure out how it works. Leaving it as it is.
Shut it off. Thirty seconds later it switched itself back on.
It shocked me.

intro: Olazábal's bakery. The shutter's down, but there's light inside.
Someone lives here.

text: Olazábal's son opened the door. He recognized me. We both cried.
He gave me the croissant recipe, handwritten.
success.memory: Olazábal's son and the croissant recipe

text: Nobody answered. The light went out.
It's Olazábal's son. He's alive. I'm leaving him a note.
success.memory: the note I left for Olazábal's son

text: Can't see a thing.

intro: The school annex. I built it, with two helpers.
It's still standing, boss. Still standing.

text: Not a single crack. I signed the plaster again, like I used to.
success.memory: the annex I built that's still standing

text: There's a crack. I'll have to redo it.
Sat on the steps I made. Just for a bit.
success.memory: the annex steps

text: Couldn't stay. The anger got me.

intro: My laboratory, Operator. Fourth floor.
The fridges are open. Someone has been here.

text: My notebooks are here. And others that aren't mine.
They describe an alert network. Project Echo.
success.memory: my notebooks from the lab

text: They took everything. Only empty folders left.
Medicine that's still good.
success.memory: the samples I saved from the lab

text: All expired. All of it.

intro: The signal box. Worked here thirty years.
The switch lever is still in place.

text: It's here. My crew's signatures. All of them.
Taking it.
success.memory: the logbook with my crew's signatures

text: The rain ruined it.

options.label: Throw the lever one more time

text: Clack. Like before. Over and out.
success.memory: the switch lever

text: Jammed. Like everything now.

intro: The house in the gated community. This is where I waited for my mom.
She never came back.

text: It was under the mattress. Says she loves me. Says to go south if she doesn't come back.
That's it. Now I know.
success.memory: my mom's letter

text: Couldn't find it. Maybe there never was a letter.
Left my cap on the table. In case she comes back.
success.memory: the cap I left for my mom

text: Couldn't go in. Stayed on the sidewalk.

intro: A house with a homemade antenna on the roof.
Inside, a ham radio rig with the dial marked.

text: Frequencies marked in pencil. One says "VOICE" and it's underlined three times.
success.memory: the ham radio operator's marked dial

text: The handwriting's illegible. Shame.
Tubes, coils. For the workshop.
It all fell apart in my hands.

intro: The temperature dropped all at once. Frost on everything.
My hands are shaking.

text: A small fire in a drum. It passes.
It won't light. Spent the night shivering.
Walked all night. Made it in one piece.
My fingers froze.
I can keep going, but it hurts.
